epic_n_patients.short_description: Monthly total patient count used as the denominator for the heat-related illness percentage.
epic_n_patients.long_description: Monthly total count of patients, used as the denominator for epic_pct_hri. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2860390. Population base: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Residence = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - this is the entire Epic patient population for the state/month, NOT a cohort restricted to heat-related illness or emergency department visits. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. In practice no state or the national total ever hits this threshold - only small territories (which are dropped before standardization) do.

epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the total patient count
epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the total patient count was suppressed and imputed.
epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the denominator cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported as "10 or fewer" or left blank) and epic_n_patients was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Where this flag is 1, epic_pct_hri is left missing rather than computed from an imputed denominator.

epic_pct_hri.long_name: Percent of Patients with Any Heat-Related Illness
epic_pct_hri.short_description: Monthly percent of all patients with a heat-related illness (HRI) diagnosis of any severity.
epic_pct_hri.long_description: Monthly percent of all patients (epic_n_patients, NOT an emergency-department-only or heat-illness-only cohort) diagnosed with a heat-related illness of any severity (all HRI levels combined; individual high/medium/low severity levels are not included). Because the denominator is the entire patient population and heat illness is rare, most cells are affected by suppression or Epic's percentage rounding - see epic_pct_hri_suppressed_flag for how these are imputed. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2860390; population base All Patients, Country of Residence = United States of America, Has Any Encounters.
epic_pct_hri.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients had a heat-related illness diagnosis.

epic_pct_hri_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression/imputation flag for the all-severity heat-related illness percent
epic_pct_hri_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the heat-related illness percent was suppressed, bounded, or otherwise imputed.
epic_pct_hri_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when epic_pct_hri was not a directly reported value, for any of three reasons: (1) the numerator cell was suppressed (10 or fewer patients, shown blank by Epic) and imputed as 5 / epic_n_patients * 100; (2) Epic reported the cell as the bounded string "<0.01%" (a numerator > 10 but small relative to the multi-million-patient denominator) and it was imputed at half the bound, 0.005; or (3) the denominator itself (epic_n_patients) was suppressed, in which case the percent is left missing rather than computed from an imputed denominator - see epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. 0 when Epic reported an exact, unbounded percentage. Flags are computed before imputation. Because the population base is All Patients rather than a heat-illness-specific cohort, most cells fall into case (1) or (2); this is expected given how rare heat illness is relative to the entire patient population and is not a data quality issue.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
